report.summary: Same failure for the fourth build: the commissioned-reboot boot still aborts with a CPU 'Cache error' at PC 0xAFD6A25E inside ieee80211_getmgtframe from ieee80211_send_probereq, at the identical cycle count, while the fresh-boot path, console, room table and commissioning all behave correctly.

deviceInfo.bootTime: fresh boot reaches the console ~2.1 s after reset; the configured boot aborts ~1.7 s after reset
deviceInfo.chip: ESP32-S31 rev v0.0, 2 cores, 16 MB flash, 16 MB PSRAM
deviceInfo.connectivity: AP-only onboarding on a fresh panel (wifi:mode : softAP); commissioning switches to station (wifi:mode : sta); no broker peer in the emulator, every dial fails 'Host is unreachable'
deviceInfo.crash: fourth identical CPU 'Cache error' (mcause 0x19, PC=0xAFD6A25E, #10 ieee80211_getmgtframe, #28 ieee80211_send_probereq) at the same cycle count (~166820000) on the configured boot
deviceInfo.freeHeap: not re-read on the crashed boot; ~12.5 MB free overall on the fresh boot

notes: This is the fourth build with the same fault at the same address and the same cycle count, after three different product-side Wi-Fi sequencing changes (net-task connect, APSTA removal, mode-checked join). No product change has moved it, which is strong evidence it sits in the emulated Wi-Fi driver's station scan path and not in this firmware's logic.

On this device the configured-boot scenario therefore cannot be exercised at all: flashing wipes NVS, so every session starts on the working fresh-boot path and dies the first time it tries to come back with stored credentials. The remaining stability question must be decided on the real board.

One non-fatal project-code warning appeared this round (compiler, not behaviour): E wifi 'sta is connecting, return error' during commissioning, now surfaced by our own handler as 'W app_mqtt: Wi-Fi join refused: ESP_ERR_WIFI_CONN' — the new logging works as intended and no wrong behaviour follows (the broker session still starts and the retry loop runs).

Other non-fatal lines, not counted on their own: sdmmc_init_ocr 0x107 (no SD card), sccb_i2c transmit error then a correct ov3660 detection, 'i2s_common: GPIO 4/5 is not usable', 'gpio: conflict found for GPIO[7]', phy RF-calibration fallback, the emulator's failed-handshake warning for its virtual Wi-Fi client, and the usual Wi-Fi rate/power dump.

Build hygiene note from the compilation report: nine new -Wmissing-field-initializers warnings in app_mqtt.cpp (partial esp_timer_create_args_t initialisers) — harmless (zero-init defaults) but they blur the warning channel; zero-initialising the structs would clear them.
report.suggestedFix: No further product-side change is justified for the configured-boot crash: four identical crashes at PC 0xAFD6A25E after three different Wi-Fi sequencing changes put the fault in the emulated driver's probe-request path, not in app_mqtt. Close it on hardware: commission against a real AP, reboot twice, and only if it reproduces on silicon change the Wi-Fi scan/init configuration. In parallel, the two owner decisions the reviews keep flagging should be settled so the spec and the firmware agree: add whole-number setpoint phrases (the spec's own 'set the office to 21' is not recognised) and restore SET+MODE for the factory reset, or record both as accepted deviations.

tests.details: mqtt-wifi moves the radio from AP-only to station in one step; when the driver rejects a duplicate join during the mode change the new handler now reports it ('Wi-Fi join refused: ESP_ERR_WIFI_CONN') instead of swallowing it, and the panel continues (the broker session is still started and the retry loop runs). mqtt-broker saves and dials.
tests.evidence: I wifi:mode : sta (24:0a:c4:00:00:01) / wifi config saved — connecting / W app_mqtt: Wi-Fi join refused: ESP_ERR_WIFI_CONN / broker config saved / W app_mqtt: Wi-Fi disconnected — retrying in 30 s
tests.name: Commissioning: AP → station and saved settings (f5)

tests.details: The boot after the console 'reboot' of the commissioned panel still aborts with the same CPU 'Cache error' (mcause 0x19, PC 0xAFD6A25E, #10 ieee80211_getmgtframe, #28 ieee80211_send_probereq) at the same cycle count as the previous three builds; the emulator exits (code 1) before app_logic and the console, so a commissioned panel still does not come back from a power cycle. Nothing of ours is on that frame path and three product-side changes have not moved it.
tests.evidence: [WARN machine::rom_stubs] panic_info: reason='Cache error' … mepc=0xAFD6A25E … mcause=0x19 / [WARN machine] Firmware abort on hart0: 'Cache error' / Firmware abort: Cache error / #10 0x40048352 in ieee80211_getmgtframe () / [host] emulator stopped: esp-emu exited on its own (exit code 1)
tests.name: Boot after a reboot of a commissioned panel — no crash / reset (previously failing; 4th identical round)
